paragraphs: Explore the purpose, regions and example outcomes of each programme.

items.title: Afya Mkononi (Mobile Diagnostics)
items.description: Deploying custom-engineered solar-backed medical vans into rural hamlets where the nearest clinical laboratory is over 25 kilometers away.

paragraphs: The reference outcomes below are demo claims, not verified results.

outcomes: Over 180,000 citizens tested with zero fee
Point-of-care HbA1c & lipids delivered on site
Digital integration with national health records

items.title: Shule Afya (School Wellness & Vision)
items.description: School-based screening detecting refractive errors, nutritional deficiencies, and congenital heart anomalies in primary and secondary students.

paragraphs: The reference outcomes below are demo claims, not verified results.

items.title: Mama na Mtoto Salama (Safe Motherhood)
items.description: Community-based ultrasound mapping and pre-eclampsia screening for pregnant mothers in remote wards with direct ambulance linkage.

paragraphs: The reference outcomes below are demo claims, not verified results.

outcomes: 98% early detection of gestational risk factors
Zero maternal mortalities during caravan interventions
